source_method: Official CrashCourse channel (@crashcourse, UCX6b17PVsYBQ0ip5gyeme-Q). Series playlist IDs were taken from the public channel playlists tab (47 playlists, fetched 21 Nov 2026 with yt-dlp --flat-playlist) and from public pages that list official series playlists YouTube no longer surfaces on that tab (thecrashcourse.com course list; Crash Course Tumblr AP review post; public YouTube playlist pages; official channel search, which still returns the hidden Literature 2–4 and Film Production playlist IDs). Each playlist was fetched with `yt-dlp --flat-playlist -J` and kept only when playlist and video channel_id was UCX6b17PVsYBQ0ip5gyeme-Q. Videos that appear in more than one playlist were assigned to the primary official series (title match, then series over compilation/highlight). Bloopers, outtakes and Recess were excluded. oEmbed was spot-checked via https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=...&format=json.

gaps.crash_course_kids: Crash Course Kids is a separate official brand channel (UCONtPx56PSebXJOxbFv-2jQ), outside the locked @crashcourse / UCX6b17PVsYBQ0ip5gyeme-Q allowlist, so it was not included.
gaps.spanish_courses: Biología and Fundamentos de Química live on the Crash Course en Español channel, not @crashcourse, so they were not included.
gaps.arabic_world_history: The official CrashCourse playlist 'Crash Course World History in Arabic' (PL8dPuuaLjXtPfI7iNFFINDNkuxnvl88w3) is on @crashcourse, but all 42 videos are hosted on DW عربية (UC30ditU5JI16o5NbFsHde_Q), so they were not allowlisted.
gaps.geology_extra_curricular_cross_channel: 38 videos in the official 'Geology Extra Curricular' playlist are SciShow or PBS Eons, not @crashcourse, so they were not allowlisted. The 10 CrashCourse videos in that playlist were kept via their primary series.
